cues.text: Who's the girl next door living in the haunted mansion?
cues.translation: 옆집 유령 저택에 사는 소녀는 누구

cues.text: You better learn my name 'cause it's Ashley!
She knows the darkest spells and she brews the meanest potions
cues.translation: 가장 어두운 주문도 알고 가장 독한 물약도 만들어

cues.text: You might be the ingredient I seek
Don't let yourself be fooled by her innocent demeanor
You better be afraid of the great Ashley
She doesn't play with dolls and she never combs her hair
cues.translation: 인형 갖고 놀지도 머리 빗지도 않아

cues.text: Who has time for girly things like that?
cues.translation: 그런 여자애 같은 일 할 시간이 어디 있어

cues.text: Eye of newt - I cast a hex on you
Grandma's wig - this'll make you big
Kitten spit - soon your pants won't fit
cues.translation: 새끼 고양이 침으로 곧 바지가 안 맞을걸

cues.text: Pantalones Giganticus!
Oh no, not again!
She can rule the world and still finish all her homework
cues.translation: 세상을 다스리고도 숙제는 다 끝낼 수 있어

cues.text: Everyone knows I'm the greatest Ashley!
cues.translation: 모두가 알아 내가 최고의 애슐리란 걸

cues.text: You better watch your step or she'll cast a spell on you
cues.translation: 발밑 조심해 안 그러면 네게 주문을 걸 테니

cues.text: I turned my teacher into a spoon
I'm a slave to my spells
And yes it's true, well
I don't have as many friends as you
But I think you're nice and maybe we could be friends
cues.translation: 하지만 넌 괜찮은 애 같아 우리 친구가 될 수도 있겠지

cues.text: And if you say no, you're toast

cues.translation: 옆집 유령 저택에 사는 소녀는 누구

cues.text: You better learn my name 'cause it's Ashley
Just remember this when you see her on the street
I'm the coolest girl you'll ever meet
